messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Linear regression with multiple variables
parts:
Look here:

https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE-Additions

You'll an outline. The code there doesn't work (i tried, needs to be tweaked) but you get the drift.
A basic implementation of 

(X'X)^{-1}X'Y

without any optimizations for factors (causes X, the model matrix to be sparse). Uses model.matrix function from R to help things along.

Cheer
Saptarshi
